decided: With nothing configured, a sensor that fires is recorded and shown nowhere: no status screen, gate, review or prompt changes, and the only place it appears is the brief, whose tripwires line lists what fired.
alternatives: show a one-line report wherever a sensor fires, which would need a named exception to G0
run sensors only when a setting turns them on
why: G0 keeps a default install behaving as it does today with no new exception, while the trial can still count every firing, including those in stretches where nothing is set to stop.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
